# agentwheel-registry

> Public registry and generated catalogue data for Agentwheel-installable resources.

## Start Here

- README: https://github.com/NestDevLab/agentwheel-registry#readme
- Agent guide: https://github.com/NestDevLab/agentwheel-registry/blob/main/AGENT.md
- Publish guide: https://github.com/NestDevLab/agentwheel-registry/blob/main/catalogue/publish.md
- Catalogue docs: https://github.com/NestDevLab/agentwheel-registry/blob/main/catalogue/README.md
- Public catalogue: https://nestdevlab.github.io/agentwheel/catalogue.html

## Data Files

- Registry index: https://github.com/NestDevLab/agentwheel-registry/blob/main/index.json
- Catalogue data: https://github.com/NestDevLab/agentwheel-registry/blob/main/catalogue-data.json
- Vercel compact index: https://github.com/NestDevLab/agentwheel-registry/blob/main/catalogue-vercel-index.json

## Validation

```bash
CRAWL_CAP=0 OPENPACK_CRAWL_CAP=0 MCP_REGISTRY_CRAWL_CAP=0 CLAWHUB_CRAWL_CAP=0 node catalogue/build.mjs --check
```
